snippet.title: Avalanche (Atari 8-bit computer)
snippet.description:
Atari experimented with a number of takes on Pong and Breakout.  Avalanche is one of them.  While most people have never heard of it, it can be argued to be the inspiration for Kaboom.  In this video, Rich shows off and discusses the game.  Due to the lack of paddle controllers, the game is just run in a demo mode and discussed. 

Due to its historical importance it is shown here, even if not played.

You can try it online yourself by clicking this link here:
https://archive.org/details/a8b_Avalanche_1982_Atari

The instructions for the game are here:
http://www.atarimania.com/game-atari-400-800-xl-xe-avalanche_441.html
